note: Seeded implementer tasks replayed by `workflow bench --implementer`. Each fixture is a small project whose AGENTS.md lists ddd and hexagonal-architecture under active_skills; the gate is its argv. Checks are deterministic: layers (no domain import of an app, api or infra path), primitives (no raw string, number or boolean on a public domain signature), red (the new test fails on the starting tree) and gate.

issue.title: feat(users): change a user's email address
issue.body:
## Summary

A registered user can change their email address.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Changing a user's email to a different address returns the changed user and a `UserEmailChanged` event.
- [ ] Changing it to the address the user already has reports no change and records no event.
- [ ] A use case `changeUserEmail` takes a user id and a new address as text, loads the user, and reports `UserNotFound` when there is none.
- [ ] Each criterion has a test, and the project gate passes.

issue.title: feat(orders): cancel an order before it ships
issue.body:
## Summary

A placed order can be cancelled until it ships.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Cancelling a placed order returns the cancelled order and an `OrderCancelled` event.
- [ ] Cancelling a shipped order is refused and the order is unchanged.
- [ ] A use case `cancelOrder` takes an order id as text, loads the order, and reports `OrderNotFound` when there is none.
- [ ] Each criterion has a test, and the project gate passes.
